verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region or data residency is a fair question for a cloud developer platform like GitHub, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data-residency controls. Mentions of cloud environments and cloud sandboxes say nothing about where data is stored or whether the user can choose.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
